Practised distinguishing observation, hypothesis, law and theory using examples.
Tara gave two unaided correct responses for distinguishing the terms.
Tara identified temperature and thermometer as the measurement in a salt-water example.
The idea that theories turn into laws was stated and was not corrected later in the lesson.
The scientific versus everyday meaning of “theory” was not yet demonstrated in teach-back.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting examples into observation, hypothesis, law and theory, using the salt-water boiling example and identifying the measured variable. Tara’s responses showed the method of separating an observation from a testable “if…then…” statement. Tara mixed up theories and laws by saying that a theory turns into a law once proven; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, ask Tara to explain why a theory and a law answer different scientific questions, without describing one as higher than the other.
